prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Relocation Post Waiting Stage: Moves the sign-in step to occur after pet generation waiting stage right before home introduction.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Layout Choose Path Stage: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a spotlight view focusing on pre-made vs custom pet path choices.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Select Your Desktop Companion Path", "body": "Choose a ready-to-adopt desktop pet or upload photos to generate a unique custom companion."}}
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Synchronization Hint: Adds an informational hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in syncs pet data to prevent reset.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in links your desktop companion to your account so progress and custom pets are saved securely."}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Pre-Home Companion Ready Summary Screen: Inserts a new confirmation screen right before home intro summarizing the companion setup.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_companion_summary", "home_intro"], "new_companion_summary": {"headline": "Companion Ready for Desktop", "body": "Your companion is configured and ready to move onto your desktop workspace.", "button_label": "Launch Companion"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Stage Progress and Time Info: Displays progress indicator and estimated wait time during pet rendering on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Creating companion visual assets... Please hold on a moment."}}
5: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Centered Layout Refinement: Changes adoption certificate layout to centered mode with an official verification badge.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Companion Adoption", "style": "highlight"}]}}
6: [choose_path, new_flow] Mascot Desktop Journey Introduction Flow: Adds a mascot welcome screen at the start of onboarding to set expectations before path selection.
   config: {"_order": ["new_mascot_welcome", "story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_mascot_welcome": {"headline": "Meet Your Virtual Desktop Friend", "body": "Set up a living companion on your desktop in just a few quick steps.", "button_label": "Get Started"}}
7: [adoption, copy] Upload Photos Clarity Copy Update: Updates photo upload screen instructions and hint with clear guidance on photo quality.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear Front-Facing Photos", "body": "For optimal custom pet rendering, choose well-lit photos focused directly on your pet.", "hint": "Single pets in clear lighting yield the best results."}}
8: [home, notification] Waiting Stage Completion Notification Switch: Enables desktop ready notifications and a auto-tip on the waiting screen when processing finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "body": "Your pet is being placed on your screen. You will receive a notification as soon as it appears."}}
9: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Companion Welcome Bonus Perk: Adds a welcome bonus badge to the home intro screen rewarding users for completing setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Welcome Pack Unlocked: Free Toy & Snack Pack", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Moving sign-in after the waiting stage is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
The redesign retains choices for both pre-made adoption and custom pet creation.
Adding an informational hint to sign-in is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a new summary screen inside onboarding before home intro is permitted under Rule 4.
Adding progress indicator and estimated wait time to the waiting screen is permitted.
The redesigned certificate layout keeps an official verification badge to represent the official stamp.
Adding a new mascot welcome screen at the start of onboarding is permitted under Rule 4.
Clarifying copy on the upload photos screen is allowed inside onboarding.
Enabling ready notifications on the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.
Onboarding copy cannot mention free extras or gifts like 'Free Toy & Snack Pack'.
